name: BRTheme FAQ
author: Md. Akhtaruzzaman Rony

sections.description:
BRTheme FAQ provides a lightweight way to display Frequently Asked Questions using a custom post type, a shortcode, and a tiny Elementor widget. Add FAQs in the admin (FAQs → Add New), order with Page Attributes (menu order), then place the [brtheme_faq] shortcode where you need it.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin from the plugin upload option, or install from the WordPress.org repository.
  2. Add FAQ items under the “FAQs” menu in the admin.
  3. Use the shortcode: [brtheme_faq]
  4. Or add the BRTheme FAQ widget if using Elementor.

For basic usage, have a look at the plugin’s website.
